storyPoints.description: Since 2017, all islands are experiencing a sea level rise of at least 1cm.
1997 was the last year to see an average surface temperature anomaly of 0°C (over all islands).
The islands were burning in 2024. All but one country (Pitcairn Islands) experienced increased surface temperatures.
Kiribati reached a 1.2°C surface temperature increase in 2015. Vanuatu followed in 2022 with 1.2°C as well.
